## R_V_U_NoD_NOSS

\begin{align}
  \frac{d}{dt} R & = \delta_{R}R - q_{R, V} R + q_{V, R} V \\
  \frac{d}{dt} V & = \delta_{V}V - q_{V, R} V + q_{R, V} R - q_{V, U} V + q_{U, V} U \\
  \frac{d}{dt} U & = \delta_{U}U - q_{U, V} U + q_{V, U} V 
\end{align}

```{r}

path_mdls_2_compare <- c(
  "ms_Simulations/mdl_AB_Ct_strain_PAS_VAR_deltaU_qVU"
  ) 

str_mdls_nickname <- c(
  "Final.Ct_PAS"
)
```




```{r}

df_mdls_2_compare <- data.frame(mdl_nickname=str_mdls_nickname, mdl_dir=path_mdls_2_compare) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sml_dir=str_replace(mdl_dir, "mdl_", "sml_pop_"))
df_mdls_2_compare %>% 
  flextable::flextable() %>% 
  flextable::theme_zebra()
```



```{r}
ii <- 1
df_mdls_parameters_2_compare <- lapply(
  seq_along(path_mdls_2_compare),
  function(ii) get_onecol_tbl(path_mdls_2_compare[ii], mdl_nickname = str_mdls_nickname[ii])
) %>% 
  purrr::reduce(full_join, by=c("parameter")) 

```

## Parameters Comparisons {.tabset}


### BICc order
```{r}
# v_models_BICc_order <- 
df_BICc_model_comparisons <- get_df_params_pop_omega(df_mdls_parameters_2_compare, param_type = "fit") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(parameter == "BICc") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-parameter, -param_type) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "model", values_to = "BICc" ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(BICc) 

v_models_BICc_levels <- df_BICc_model_comparisons %>% pull(model)

df_BICc_model_comparisons %>% 
  flextable::flextable() %>% 
  flextable::theme_zebra()
```


### Fiting criteria
```{r}
get_df_params_pop_omega(df_mdls_parameters_2_compare, param_type = "fit") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(param_type = "") %>%
  dplyr::select(parameter, param_type, everything()) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-param_type) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate( across(everything(), ~f_replace_to_fix(.x) ) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_all(~replace_na(., "")) %>% 
  get_flx_tbl_monolix()
  
```



### Population parameters
```{r}
get_df_params_pop_omega(df_mdls_parameters_2_compare, param_type = "pop") %>% 
  # dplyr::mutate(param_type = "") %>% 
  dplyr::select(parameter, param_type, everything()) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate( across(everything(), ~f_replace_to_fix(.x) ) ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_all(~replace_na(., "")) %>% 
  get_flx_tbl_monolix()
  
```


### Omega parameters
```{r}
get_df_params_pop_omega(df_mdls_parameters_2_compare, param_type = "omega") %>% 
  # dplyr::mutate(param_type = "") %>% 
  dplyr::select(parameter, param_type, everything()) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate( across(everything(), ~f_replace_to_fix(.x) ) ) %>% 
  dplyr::select_if(~ !all(is.na(.))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_all(~replace_na(., "")) %>% 
  get_flx_tbl_monolix()
  
```





```{r}
ii <- 1
df_sml_indvidual_parameters <- get_sml_individual_parameters(df_mdls_2_compare$sml_dir[ii]) 

df_sml_indvidual_parameters_Stats <- df_sml_indvidual_parameters %>% 
  dplyr::select(-group, -VolU) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -id,names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value" ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(parameter %in% c("deltaU", "qVU")) %>% 
  group_by(parameter) %>% 
  nest() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$value, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>% 
  unnest(Stats) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(model=NA)

df_sml_indvidual_parameters_Stats
```


```{r}
v_IDs_2_exclude <- df_sml_indvidual_parameters %>% 
  dplyr::filter(deltaU < -15.12123 | deltaU > -4.262853 | qVU < 40.05858	| qVU > 87.740004 ) %>% 
  pull(id) %>% 
  unique()
```

```{r}
        dplyr::rename("obs"="log10CFUV") %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(obsid=ifelse(is.na(obs), NA, "log10CFUV")) %>% 
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(obsid)) %>% 
        # dplyr::filter(group == "simulationGroup1") %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(model=df_mdls_2_compare$mdl_nickname[ii] )

      get_sml_simulated_data(df_mdls_2_compare$sml_dir[ii]) %>%

        dplyr::mutate(model=df_mdls_2_compare$mdl_nickname[ii] )
    }
  
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows()
```

```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=6}
dir_mlx_ii <- df_mdls_2_compare$mdl_dir[1]

df_yR <- get_observations(dir_mlx_ii, "yR") %>%
  dplyr::rename("TIME"="time") %>%
  dplyr::rename("obs"="observation") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(obsid="log10CFUR")

df_yV <- get_observations(dir_mlx_ii, "yV") %>%
  dplyr::rename("TIME"="time") %>% 
  dplyr::rename("obs"="observation") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(obsid="log10CFUV") 

df_yU <- get_observations(dir_mlx_ii, "yU") %>%
  dplyr::rename("TIME"="time") %>%
  dplyr::rename("obs"="observation") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(obsid="log10CFUU")

df_obs <- bind_rows(
  list(df_yR, df_yV, df_yU)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(group="data") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(model=NA)


df_obs_Stats <- df_obs %>% group_by(TIME, variable, obsid) %>% 
  nest() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$obs, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>% 
  unnest(Stats) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(model=NA)
  
```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=6}

lbl_y <- ""
lbl_x <- "time (days)"
lbl_subtitle <- "Simulated Mice"
# df_sim_pop_mdls_2_compare %>% pull(ID) %>% unique()

df_sim_pop_mdls_2_compare %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!ID %in% v_IDs_2_exclude) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=TIME, y=obs, color=model, group=ID)) +
  geom_line(size=0.5, alpha=0.5) +
  # geom_point(data=df_obs, color="black") +
  # geom_line(data=df_obs_Stats, aes(y=q50), color="black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~factor(obsid, v_CFU_levels), labeller = as_labeller(nv_CFU_labels)) +
  labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y, subtitle = lbl_subtitle) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = nv_tmp_levels_colors) +
  # facet_wrap(~obsid) +
  # labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y, subtitle = lbl_subtitle) +
  scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color="red", linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype="dotted") +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(-1, 9)
  ) +
  # scale_x_log10() +
  theme_ano +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "white" )) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'white', face="bold", size = 15)) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA) ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

### Time to LOD

```{r}
df_sim_pop_mdls_2_compare
```



```{r}
# df_sim_pop_mdls_2_compare %>% 
#   group_by()
```



```{r}
# df_indiv_mdls_2_compare
df_frac_LOD <- df_sim_pop_mdls_2_compare %>% 
  dplyr::filter(TIME > 0) %>% 
  # dplyr::filter(TIME %% 2 == 0, TIME > 0) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(below_LOD = ifelse(obs<1, 1 , 0)) %>% 
  group_by(TIME, obsid) %>% 
  summarize(
    frac_below_LOD = sum(below_LOD)/n()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

fraction_threshold <- 0.8
df_ttt <- df_frac_LOD %>% 
  dplyr::filter(frac_below_LOD >= fraction_threshold) %>% 
  group_by(obsid) %>% 
  summarise(time_2_LOD_80p = min(TIME)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(time_2_LOD_80p)
df_ttt %>% knitr::kable()
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}

lbl_x <- "time (days)"
lbl_y <- "Fraction of Cleared"
df_frac_LOD %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=TIME, y=frac_below_LOD)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = fraction_threshold, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y) +
  facet_wrap(~obsid, labeller = as_labeller(nv_CFU_labels)) +
  theme_ano +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "white" )) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'white', face="bold", size = 15)) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA) )

```





```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=3}

lbl_x <- "time (days)"
lbl_y <- "Cleared fraction"
lbl_color <- "Organ"
plt <- df_frac_LOD %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(dummy="") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=TIME, y=frac_below_LOD, color=obsid)) +
  geom_line(size=1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = fraction_threshold, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = nv_CFU_colors, labels=nv_CFU_labels) +
  geom_vline(data = df_ttt, aes(xintercept = time_2_LOD_80p, color=obsid), inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y, color=lbl_color) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(20,70)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 6) +
  facet_wrap(~dummy) +
  # facet_wrap(~obsid, labeller = as_labeller(nv_CFU_labels)) +
  theme_ano +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.82, 0.4)) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white" )) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black', face="bold", size = 15)) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA) )

plt_cleared_fraction <- plt
print(plt)
ggsave("plt_final_model_Ct_PAS_Clearence_Simul.pdf", plot=plt)

```
